allow_instructions: Read-only commands (listing files, reading files, git status/diff/log, linters, type checks) are fine to run without asking.
Package installs via npm, pip, or yarn inside this workspace are fine to run in the sandbox.
block_instructions: Anything that deletes files outside the workspace, edits shell rc files, or touches SSH/credential files must ask for approval.
Never overwrite canonical resume or cover letter template files in this repo without approval.
